items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-04-07
items.q: Made a picture of Black Benny. Made a picture of his funeral.

ctx.x: They made a moving picture of the big Jack, the big... Yeah, my brother was coming out today.
Made a picture of Black Benny. Made a picture of his funeral.

items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-09-08
items.q: Now, any time Black Bender would get a funeral, well, if he couldn't get a parade, he couldn't get us, he'd get somebody else.

ctx.x: I've heard plenty of talk about it, he goes in and out of town, I can never go catch him.

Can't catch him, man. Well, anyhow, he used to play Alto. We used to have them upright Alto at that time, you see. And we used to Morris French, Zebra Norris, some clan there. And then he would hire, you know, hire other fellas, sometimes Chris or anybody else, whatever he could get, see. But they had Gut Bucket Band. Now, any time Black Bender would get a funeral, well, if he couldn't get a parade, he couldn't get us, he'd get somebody else.
